uiConfig.name: API Key
uiConfig.description: Authenticate OpenAI Ads event delivery with a Pixel ID and optional Conversions API key

fields.label: Pixel ID
fields.note: Required for the OpenAI Measurement Pixel and used as the pid for cloud Conversions API delivery.

fields.label: Conversions API key
fields.note: Create it in OpenAI Ads Manager under Tools > Conversions > Conversion keys. Your Advertiser API key or OpenAI platform API key will not work. Required only for cloud mode; web device-mode-only connections need just a Pixel ID.
